definitions.explanation: providing a feeling of freshness, energy, and pleasant stimulation

{爽快|そうかい}な⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いている→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。

notes:
{爽快|そうかい} describes an invigorating, refreshing feeling that energizes.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {爽|そう}: Refreshing, bracing
- {快|かい}: Pleasant, comfortable

FORMS:
- Attributive: {爽快|そうかい}な + noun
- Predicate: {爽快|そうかい}だ/⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧
- Adverbial: {爽快|そうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧
- Noun form: {爽快|そうかい}さ / {爽快感|そうかいかん}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爽快|そうかい}な⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧ (refreshed feeling)
- {爽快感|そうかいかん} (feeling of refreshment)
- {爽快|そうかい}な⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ (invigorating morning)
- {爽快|そうかい}な⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ (refreshing breeze)
- {爽快|そうかい}な{飲|の}み{心地|ごこち} (refreshing taste)

USAGE:
- After exercise or physical activity
- Cold beverages, especially carbonated drinks
- Fresh morning air
- After completing a task

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{清々|すがすが}しい→清々しい：07900_sugasugashii⟧ (refreshing - more gentle)
- ⟦{爽|さわ}やか→爽やか：05701_sawayaka⟧ (refreshing - lighter)
- ⟦{痛快|つうかい}→痛快：08198_tsuukai⟧ (thrilling - more excitement)

MARKETING:
- {爽快感|そうかいかん} is commonly used in beverage advertising

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday speech and advertising.
